title: Return bounded faithful command outcomes and selected explanations
statement: The system shall return operation-specific bounded outcomes whose human and machine forms preserve the same recorded meaning, selected scope, and failure distinctions, with safe diagnostics and a fitting publication receipt independent of diagnostic volume.

what.problem: Large diagnostics, unreadable narrative encoding, or misleading success and completeness labels can hide a saved correction or cause callers to infer approval.
what.desired_outcome: Callers can understand the exact command result and selected explanations without sensitive error echoes, partial output, or semantic dependence on log lookup.

why.rationale: An automation result must support safe continuation while preserving the actor-authored evidence and reasoning needed for engineering judgment.

stakeholders: Engineers and reviewers operating on recorded engineering work
Engineering agents acting on explicit actor decisions
Maintainers and consumers of the published command-line interface

conditions: For selected query, preview, mutation, maintenance, installation and diagnostic outcomes.

contexts: Each published result/projection domain, its selected records, bounded receipt, and separately requested observations.

how.approach: Preserve actual outcome and complete selected meaning in the family-specific bounded result. Establish a fitting receipt before commitment; never convert a committed effect into rejection because output failed.

how_much.scope: Current family-specific outcome/exit meanings and bounded result schemas remain authoritative in CLI. Mechanical detail is opt-in; logs are not a prerequisite for understanding the semantic result. This adds no alternative authoritative assessment or cached report. The local operational-history extension adds the criteria attributed to SRC-LOCAL-OPERATIONAL-ANALYSIS; retained product contracts and old allocation evidence do not establish implementation or coverage of that extension.

acceptance_criteria: Saved, unchanged, preview, rejected, conflict, busy, and recovery-needed outcomes retain their exact operation/version/exit meanings and available identities. A recording receipt claims persistence only; errors and observations remain distinct and never echo arbitrary payloads or secrets.

Text and JSON preserve equivalent selected fields, state, omissions, optional absence, and decoded narrative, including paragraphs, code, Unicode, literal backslash sequences, and ordered arrays. Budget failure occurs before output rather than emitting truncated content.

Every admissible mutation has a prepublication mandatory receipt that fits independently of diagnostic volume. Excess optional details are explicitly omitted; increasing diagnostics cannot reject a sound correction or turn completed publication into rejected output.

Current context identifies the selected scope, available selectors and explicit omissions. Compared observations remain scope-limited and separate from attributed judgments; no cursor or observation-detail continuation protocol is required.
Selected Review and Verification accounts derive from stored values without inventing rationale, conflating absent support with approval or treating complete retrieval as engineering adequacy.
Each supported public family preserves actual effects, safe-continuation facts and its declared exit meaning across admitted output formats.

Backup, restoration, transfer and migration receipts identify their selected project, captured or restored scope, state identity, exclusions and actual completeness. Storage completion does not establish current evidence applicability or engineering approval.
